WHERE t.team_name <> 'Golden State Warriors'
  AND o.birth_date IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS { MATCH (o)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) }
  AND (
    2026 - CAST(regexp_extract(o.birth_date, '([0-9]{4})', 1) AS INT64)
    - CASE
        WHEN (
          CASE
            WHEN regexp_matches(o.birth_date, '^[0-9]{4}/')
            THEN CAST(regexp_extract(o.birth_date, '^[0-9]{4}/([0-9]{1,2})/', 1) AS INT64)
            WHEN lower(o.birth_date) CONTAINS 'january' THEN 1
            WHEN lower(o.birth_date) CONTAINS 'february' THEN 2
            WHEN lower(o.birth_date) CONTAINS 'march' THEN 3
            WHEN lower(o.birth_date) CONTAINS 'april' THEN 4
            WHEN lower(o.birth_date) CONTAINS 'may' THEN 5
            WHEN lower(o.birth_date) CONTAINS 'june' THEN 6
            WHEN lower(o.birth_date) CONTAINS 'july' THEN 7
            WHEN lower(o.birth_date) CONTAINS 'august' THEN 8
            WHEN lower(o.birth_date) CONTAINS 'september' THEN 9
            WHEN lower(o.birth_date) CONTAINS 'october' THEN 10
            WHEN lower(o.birth_date) CONTAINS 'november' THEN 11
            WHEN lower(o.birth_date) CONTAINS 'december' THEN 12
            ELSE 1
          END
        ) > 10
        OR (
          (
            CASE
              WHEN regexp_matches(o.birth_date, '^[0-9]{4}/') THEN CAST(regexp_extract(o.birth_date, '^[0-9]{4}/([0-9]{1,2})/', 1) AS INT64)
              WHEN lower(o.birth_date) CONTAINS 'january' THEN 1
              WHEN lower(o.birth_date) CONTAINS 'february' THEN 2
              WHEN lower(o.birth_date) CONTAINS 'march' THEN 3
              WHEN lower(o.birth_date) CONTAINS 'april' THEN 4
              WHEN lower(o.birth_date) CONTAINS 'may' THEN 5
              WHEN lower(o.birth_date) CONTAINS 'june' THEN 6
              WHEN lower(o.birth_date) CONTAINS 'july' THEN 7
              WHEN lower(o.birth_date) CONTAINS 'august' THEN 8
              WHEN lower(o.birth_date) CONTAINS 'september' THEN 9
              WHEN lower(o.birth_date) CONTAINS 'october' THEN 10
              WHEN lower(o.birth_date) CONTAINS 'november' THEN 11
              WHEN lower(o.birth_date) CONTAINS 'december' THEN 12
              ELSE 1
            END
          ) = 10
          AND CASE WHEN regexp_matches(o.birth_date, '^[0-9]{4}/') THEN CAST(regexp_extract(o.birth_date, '^[0-9]{4}/[0-9]{1,2}/([0-9]{1,2})', 1) AS INT64) ELSE 1 END > 15
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0
      END
  ) >= 67
RETURN 2026 - CAST(regexp_extract(o.birth_date, '([0-9]{4})', 1) AS INT64) AS col1, t.team_name AS col2, o.name AS col3, o.name AS name_manager
